It specifically addresses differentiating with respect to scene parameters theta (theta), noting that when scene geometry M depends on theta (object shape parameters), the path space changes, requiring this specific formulation involving boundary integrals. Both sources confirm the method estimates derivatives of the path integral using interior and boundary terms for differentiable rendering with respect to shape parameters.
